title: hepatica henryi
intro: Hepatica henryi, commonly known as Henry's liverwort or Chinese liverleaf, is a type of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine and is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hepatica henryi include anti-inflammatory and immune-boosting effects, which may help to treat conditions such as fever, sore throats, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Hepatica henryi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
